title: Animal population route-work and camera-facing fixture measurements
acceptance_criteria: Does the settled camera-facing fixture capture the expected population, actual animal rendering and authenticated committed ownership while retaining per-case join logs?
What phase-attributed route work, server tick, client frame and separate JVM GC evidence accompanies 100 parrots, 100 kobolds and 40 mixed animals?

checks.rationale: Lead-owned isolated real client/server measurement with 100 parrots. Measure actual route collision/support work without changing routing behavior. Verify settled fixture geometry and actual renderer calls; retain individual join proof, logs and recordings. Existing native limits and process lifecycle remain unchanged.
